_what: Studio checks each motion against its rig. A blocked straight path uses a quick connect seed and RRT* parent selection/rewiring, then checked shortcuts. Final wire-rounded legs and endpoints are rechecked. Budgets bound search; failure holds instead of sending an unchecked path. Data settings also control the yielding live planner. musicGapMm: extra clearance for sequences at the music pace (no speed cap, user 2026-10-27): at full servo speed the real arm lags and cuts corners, so the simulator (tools/nong_sim) found hands meeting that Studio passed with the normal gap; the value is the one the sim's rounds needed. clearMm: the gap every collision check keeps between two parts (Studio, its RRT* paths, video and gesture moves, and tools/nong_sim near misses); 5 mm allows for servo backlash (user 2026-10-27). A rig's extraClearanceMm adds to it, and musicGapMm on top at the music pace.
